purpose: Rank additional passive observations and explicitly authorized operator inspections by expected reduction in diagnostic hypothesis uncertainty, subject to declared cost, delay, risk and authority gates. This module is a read-only selector.

method.objective: Expected information gain in nats: I(H;O) = H(H) - sum_o P(o) H(H|o).
method.likelihood_contract: For every hypothesis, conditional probabilities across all declared outcomes sum to one; each likelihood table binds the exact sorted hypothesis/prior manifest.
method.prior_contract: Prior probabilities are finite, non-negative and sum to one; priors and the hypothesis label space are content-addressed.
method.calibration_contract: Likelihood model and calibration digests must be present. Their statistical calibration and signer/source trust are established upstream; digest shape alone does not prove model validity.

passive_measurement.eligible_when: Read-only access is approved and an authority-evidence digest is attached.

operator_inspection.eligible_when: Policy permits inspection, an upstream authorization state is human_authorized, and an authority-evidence digest is attached.

controlled_perturbation.disposition: Always excluded by this selector. A separate safety case, hazard analysis, system owner and explicit control authority are required; this ranking module cannot authorize or execute one.

comparators.method: Keep current posterior and stop evidence acquisition.
Choose the eligible candidate with minimum declared cost; tie-break by candidate ID.
Choose the eligible candidate with greatest expected information gain, ignoring cost/delay/risk only after hard gates.
Choose eligible candidate with greatest EIG divided by one plus normalized cost.
Choose among the exact same eligible set using a frozen seed manifest.
Proposed selector: information gain adjusted by frozen cost, delay and risk scales, after hard authority and safety gates.

hard_gates: hypothesis IDs, prior and label-space digest are fixed for the selection decision
candidate likelihood tables are calibrated on data disjoint from confirmatory evaluation
candidate manifests bind the evidence model, calibration, outcome likelihoods, cost, delay, risk and authority reference
an authority reference digest is not treated as cryptographic signer verification; upstream trust and permission checks remain mandatory
controlled perturbations are never eligible or recommended by this selector
read-only measurement candidates require upstream approved-read-only authority
operator inspections require upstream human authorization and an explicit policy enabling inspection
unknown, missing or denied authority fails closed
zero expected-information-gain candidates are not recommended by default
no sensor read, inspection, actuation, maintenance order or controller write is performed by the selector
all baselines use the identical candidate catalogue, likelihood tables and hard eligibility set
random baseline seed and comparator configuration are frozen before confirmatory outcomes

research_targets_not_achieved.target: At least 10% lower median cost-to-identification than the cheapest-eligible baseline at equal or better final diagnostic decision quality, on matched independent cases.
Higher realized posterior entropy reduction than seeded-random and cost-only baselines, with confidence intervals clustered by independent recording/engine run.
Zero unauthorized or controlled perturbations recommended; zero read-only selector execution or actuation.
No unique root-cause output when multiple hypotheses remain admissible after the selected evidence.

evidence_boundaries.data_status: No physical observation likelihoods or benchmark-selected actions have been evaluated in this workstream.
evidence_boundaries.simulation_status: Synthetic contract tests verify entropy ranking and hard exclusions only; they do not establish real diagnostic utility or safety.
evidence_boundaries.authority_status: Authorization enum and digest are caller-supplied references. Signature verification, identity, scope, expiry, issuer authority and revocation are external mandatory checks.
evidence_boundaries.claim_ceiling: Read-only ranking contract and synthetic numerical behavior only; no evidence-acquisition execution, active-control result or physical validation claim.
